\chapterpage{RESULTS / COMPLETE COMPARISON TABLES}{DocQuorum's measured standing}\label{sec:results}
Published comparison snapshots checked 5 October 2026. The following pages include every published system in UNIKIE Table 4 and ExtractBench's value-F1 leaderboard, with DocQuorum rows highlighted.

\textbf{Reference rank} compares each DocQuorum configuration independently against the published systems at their displayed two-decimal precision. Local variants do not compete with one another. These are comparison positions; no external leaderboard submission has been accepted.

\sub{How far are we from the leaders?}
ExtractBench's current leader scores 96.38. The stored primary result is 0.9522 percentage points below it and 0.6022 below the third-place score of 96.03. The incremental development result narrows these gaps to 0.7370 and 0.3870. Both configurations now have reference rank 5; the older rank-3 comparison used an earlier leaderboard snapshot.

On UNIKIE, the original configuration is 1.7250 points below the leader and 1.5250 above the published third-place score. The tuned configuration rounds to 82.37, matching Gemini-3-Pro. Its displayed first-place tie does not establish a statistically significant advantage.


\sub{What the measurements cover}
\textbf{ExtractBench:} 370 enterprise PDFs; overall unified value F1 is the unweighted mean over documents. The stored-primary row reuses the archived evaluation after prediction-hash validation. The incremental repair row is development work using stored primary outputs and fixed verifier readings, with 14 improved documents and no regressions. Neither row is fresh full inference or a held-out result.

\textbf{UNIKIE:} 4,472 documents in the constrained-category track; macro field F1 is the mean of 11 scenario scores. The three-reading row preserves the original configuration. Four and six readings were added during development; their scores must remain separate from that original result. All rows are full stored-output re-scores. The multi-category track was not evaluated here.

\sub{Sources and reproducibility}
Published baselines: \href{https://arxiv.org/html/2602.07038v2#S4.T4}{UNIKIE-BENCH, Table 4} and \href{https://github.com/run-llama/ExtractBench/blob/c972087fe7a5132132f7230d1bdb841d3fbf07ed/leaderboard.csv}{ExtractBench, pinned full CSV}. The ExtractBench dataset revision still matches our recorded evaluation, and all 95 evaluation-source files are unchanged between the recorded scorer revision and this snapshot.

{\small Local measurements: \code{results/multibench/unikie_audit.json}, \code{extractbench_current_reference.json}, and \code{extractbench_archived_candidate.json}. Frozen tables, source hashes, and a deterministic table generator are in \code{docs/results/}. No new inference was run for this section.}
